outcome.technical: (1) plugins/audit/scripts/governance/stamp-verification.py: CAUSE_RUN (a constant) replaced by _cause_run_said(stubbed, article), which describes the extra run as it was laid - each new declared test file named as an empty stub where _green_cause_run laid one, 'with nothing of the task's laid' where none; _baseline_cause's green answer now reads: HEAD's own run, the declared files laid, is not green on HEAD's code (<baseline line>), while one run of HEAD's own tree with <layout> is green (<line>): the two runs do not choose between two readings - what was laid causes the failure, or the command does not give the same answer twice; what was laid is the declared files, each file something was taken out of named with what was taken out (<rel: names>). Red answer: same prefix and run line, 'the command was red on a run of HEAD's own tree as well - narrow it to the task's cases'. Unmeasured answer: prefix unchanged. New _cause_or_raised wraps _green_cause_run alone (run_green calls it in place of _green_cause_run): an exception becomes a cause record with an internal 'raised' key (never in the payload - run['cause'] is not serialised), which _cause_answer words as 'the cause was not measured: <Name>: <message>, raised making a run of HEAD's own tree'; the two proving runs are not wrapped. Status logic, run count, payload shape and keys, and red's NARROW and red_verdict untouched. Section comments at the GREEN_WORDS block and above _cause_run_said rewritten to the new words.
